title: Public Hidden-Fee Taxonomy
status: reference framework; not a prevalence dataset
suggested_citation: DetectHiddenFees Editorial Team. Public Hidden-Fee Taxonomy, version 0.1, July 31, 2026.

categories.label: Disclosed mandatory fee
categories.definition: A required charge identified before commitment or payment.
warning_signs: base price excludes material required amount
categories.limitations: Disclosure quality and legal treatment depend on jurisdiction and transaction context.

categories.label: Poorly disclosed mandatory fee
categories.definition: A required charge whose timing, label, amount, or condition is difficult to understand before commitment.
legitimate_uses: may reflect a real cost, even when presentation is unclear
questions: Could the advertised total include it?
categories.limitations: A presentation concern is not by itself a legal conclusion.

categories.label: Optional add-on
categories.definition: A charge for an optional product or service that should be distinguishable from the required purchase.

categories.label: Automatically selected add-on
categories.definition: An optional charge selected by default unless the consumer changes the selection.
legitimate_uses: interface convenience, subject to applicable requirements
categories.limitations: The interface, jurisdiction, and transaction matter.

categories.label: Recurring fee
categories.definition: A charge that repeats while an account, subscription, or service remains active.
categories.limitations: Account history and renewal terms are necessary.

categories.label: Contract-triggered fee
categories.definition: A charge activated by a contract event such as cancellation, renewal, late payment, or exceeding a limit.
legitimate_uses: recovering committed costs or administering a contract
categories.limitations: Interpretation and enforceability require context and may require professional review.

categories.label: Duplicate or unclear charge
categories.definition: A repeated, bundled, or insufficiently described line item that requires reconciliation.
legitimate_uses: may reflect a correction or bundled service
questions: Does another line already cover it?
categories.limitations: Complete records and human confirmation are required.

methodology: Categories organize educational content and future research. They do not establish illegality, deception, prevalence, or consumer entitlement. Entries should be reviewed against the current document, source, industry, and jurisdiction.

revision_history.change: Initial public reference framework derived from Phase 3 taxonomy governance.
